# Backspace Fork 1.15.7

## Changes

- **Voice sidebar profiles:** Clicking a person in a voice channel list now opens their profile popout (name, about, mutuals, direct-message action, space roles) instead of doing nothing. Right-click moderation, drag-and-drop moves and keyboard access are preserved.
- **One-click Assistir:** Anyone sharing their screen gets an inline **Assistir** button in the sidebar. It joins the voice channel when needed, opens the room, subscribes to the stream and notifies the sharer in a single click.
- **Room-scoped watches:** A watch started in one room can no longer auto-subscribe a same-user share met after switching rooms. Switching rooms drops the previous room's watches and quarantines its stream state before connecting.
- **Quieter mini-player:** The floating picture-in-picture window now only appears while a camera or a watched screen share is actually playing. Sitting in voice with audio only no longer pops it up.
- **Rich presence for games and media:** Includes the merged game/launcher detection, game icons, media activity and profile activity improvements, with federation/IPC validation and desktop reliability fixes.
- **Maintenance:** Includes the Windows desktop test fixes and the updated security-scan baseline for resolved findings.

## Compatibility and operations

- No database migration and no minimum desktop version increase in this release. Back up the database before updating; existing users, uploads and instance identity must be preserved.
- Screen-share auto-subscription only ever follows an explicit Assistir/watch click in the room being joined. Returning to a previous room requires clicking Assistir again.
- Desktop installers for this tag are built and published by the release workflow once tag CI is green.
